==============================================================================
Cadence - Ambient Policing System for LSPDFR
Version 1.0.0
==============================================================================

QUICK INSTALLATION:
1. Drag or copy the "plugins" folder from this archive directly into your 
   Grand Theft Auto V root installation folder.
   
   Target Directory Layout:
   Grand Theft Auto V\
   └── plugins\
       └── LSPDFR\
           ├── Cadence.dll
           └── Cadence.ini

REQUIREMENTS:
- Grand Theft Auto V (latest version)
- RAGE Plugin Hook (v1.08+ or latest packaged with LSPDFR)
- LSPD First Response (0.4.9+)
- RAGENativeUI (1.9.2+ - standard in modern LSPDFR installations)

IN-GAME USAGE:
- Launch GTA V via RAGEPluginHook.exe.
- Go on duty with LSPDFR (via any police station or the 'ForceDuty' console command).
- Cadence will automatically start ambient patrols, traffic stops, and stationary units.
- Press [F8] in-game to open the Cadence Dashboard Menu.
  (The keybind can be changed or disabled in plugins\LSPDFR\Cadence.ini).

FEATURES:
- Feature 1: Ambient Cruising Patrol (natural road cruising, lane obedience, safe spawns)
- Feature 2: 1803 Roadside Traffic Stops (routine citation, driver pat-down, K9 vehicle sniff)
- Feature 3: Stationary & Speed Traps (median/turnout standby, radar gun observation, coffee, mobile)
- Feature 4A: Autonomous Background Emergency Runs (Code 2 / Code 3 runs)
- Feature 4B: Discreet Rejected Callout Takeover (ambient units respond to declined callouts)
- Feature 5: Ambient Pursuit Drafting (cruisers seamlessly drafted into active chases)
- Feature 6: Nearby Threat Reaction (cruisers halt, deploy sidearms, and neutralize armed hostiles)
- Universal Zero-Leak Radar Blips: Color-coded minimap icons with clean teardown destructor.
- Ponytail Architecture: 100% modular, delete-friendly design.

COMPATIBILITY:
- Ultimate Backup (UB): Fully integrated for jurisdiction-specific vehicles and officers.
- StopThePed (STP): 100% compatible with ped states and interactions.
- Emergency Uniforms Pack (EUP): Native clothing and duty gear support.
- Custom Callout Packs: Unobtrusive background operation without mission hijacking.

CONFIGURATION:
- Customize spawn limits, features, and keybinds in plugins\LSPDFR\Cadence.ini.

==============================================================================
